clips.title: The story
paras: Speak with Coleman is a transitional task in Tirisfal Glades offered to champions who have proven their worth against the Scourge. Deathguard Dillinger directs capable warriors from the town square to the local tavern to assist Coleman Farthing with personal and factional vendettas.

After assisting in the containment of severe local threats—such as laying to rest dangerous Scourge remnants like Ulag the Cleaver—adventurers earn the personal trust of Deathguard Dillinger. As one of the sentinels watching the roads into Brill, Dillinger judges who is capable of handling more than routine perimeter patrols and points capable fighters toward citizens in need of specialized service.

Not every conflict in Tirisfal Glades is fought on high command orders from the Undercity. Across the ruined kingdom of Lordaeron, surviving undead carry deep grudges tied to the lands, families, and fortunes they left behind. Coleman Farthing bides his time within the Gallow's End Tavern, seeking an instrument of vengeance to strike back at the threats lingering near former settlements like the Agamand Mills.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: You have proven your value to the Dark Lady, now perhaps you can prove yourself to one of her subjects.
Coleman Farthing awaits a warrior who is willing to be his instrument of revenge against the Forsaken's enemies.
You will find him in the Gallow's End Tavern in eastern Brill.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Yes, it is true. I have need for your skills in combat. My means are small, but my task aids both me and the Forsaken's cause. Do it, and your reward will be twofold.
